name: Kiro Crew
desc: Kiro's multi-agent crew that runs work spanning repos, tools and days.
desc_zh: Kiro 的多智能体编队，用来跑跨仓库、跨工具、跨多天的工作。
solves: Real engineering work spans sessions and the human ends up as the integration layer; Crew holds the context and the handoffs.
solves_zh: 真实的工程工作跨越多段会话，人最后成了集成层；Crew 负责守住上下文与交接。
best_for: An incident needs investigation across several repositories at once while you are signing off for the evening.
best_for_zh: 下班前突然要同时排查多个仓库里的故障时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed and product directory）。 Built in the open under a public MAINTAINERS.md governance model. Crew adds Apps (sharable purpose-built interfaces) and later conductor mode (2026-11-20) and bots (2026-11-06), which are capabilities of Crew rather than separate products. 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-kiro-crew/
